name: World Wrestling E-Federation Championship
epitaph: Its senior championship, carried through every held card of May 2002 by the same wrestler, defended in singles, three-way and cage matches without changing hands.

name: WWEF Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: The federation's second singles belt, defended and retained twice on held cards within three days of each other.

name: WWEF Hardcore Championship
epitaph: A singles belt defended twice on held cards in the same week, retained both times.

name: WWEF Lightweight Championship
epitaph: A singles belt for its lighter wrestlers, retained on the twenty-one-match card of 1 May 2002.

name: WWEF United States Championship
epitaph: A second singles belt held alongside the Lightweight Championship by one wrestler, retained on the card of 3 May 2002.

name: WWEF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The federation's tag-team championship, retained on the card of 4 May 2002 against a group-affiliated challenging team.
